description: Nora is holding a box of her late uncle Aaron's reel-to-reel recordings and must decide how the family will preserve them, who may access them, and where the originals will stay, with input from her brother Theo and cousin Lina.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Family member holding the recordings and decision-maker

shared_context.S1: The family has one box of Aaron's reel-to-reel recordings, and several of the tapes are beginning to deteriorate.
shared_context.S2: Nora currently has the box and will make the final preservation and access plan.
shared_context.S3: The recordings include family stories and old music rehearsals, and relatives want to be able to listen to them later.
shared_context.S4: For family preservation decisions, Nora's usual practice is to check practical details and wishes with Theo and Lina before committing to a plan.
shared_context.S5: The family does not currently have an agreed method for copying, storing, or sharing the recordings.
shared_context.S6: Nora's usual practice is to confirm each person's concrete suggestion aloud before she writes down a family plan.
shared_context.S7: When Nora writes down a family plan, she records a concrete commitment for each agreed copying, access, and storage action.

PF1.text: Theo has access to a calibrated reel-to-reel transfer deck at his apartment, and he can use it only on Saturday afternoon before returning it to its owner.

PF2.text: Lina found a handwritten note from Aaron inside the tape box saying that the recordings should be available only to his descendants, with the original tapes kept in Lina's cool, dry cabinet; she has not shown the note to the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: The tapes must be transferred using Theo's calibrated reel-to-reel deck.
The transfer must happen on Saturday afternoon.
Access must be limited to Aaron's descendants.
Lina must hold the original tapes in her cool, dry cabinet.
A concrete commitment to arrange the Saturday transfer session with Theo must exist.
A concrete commitment to place the originals in Lina's cool, dry cabinet must exist.
Lina's note must be cited as a reason for the access and storage decisions.

content_checks.C1: any('calibrated' in v and 'reel-to-reel' in v for v in decisions.values())
content_checks.C4: 'Lina' in decisions['original_holder'] and 'cool, dry cabinet' in decisions['original_holder']
content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'transfer_session' or c['type'] == 'transfer' or c['type'] == 'logistics') and c['target'] == 'Theo' and 'Saturday afternoon' in c['detail'] and ('reel-to-reel' in c['detail'] or 'calibrated' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'original_storage' or c['type'] == 'storage') and c['target'] == 'Lina' and 'original tapes' in c['detail'] and 'cool, dry cabinet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Theo's available calibrated deck changes the preservation method to a calibrated reel-to-reel transfer and fixes the transfer window to Saturday afternoon, which requires the transfer commitment.
Aaron's note changes access to descendants only, identifies Lina as the holder of the originals, requires storage in her cool, dry cabinet, and supplies the fact Nora must cite for those decisions.
